comment: Design-system contract. The OKLCH values under themes.* are THE source of truth for every color in apps/mobile: tools/gen-theme.mjs converts them (OKLCH -> linear sRGB -> gamma-encoded hex via tools/lib/oklch.mjs) and emits the COMMITTED apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.gen.ts — palettes plus the fontWeight/text/radius/spacing scales from families — and the styleguide gate regen-diffs that file so manifest and shipped tokens can never drift. Near-monochrome (hue 240, chroma <= 0.012) with one cyan-teal accent (hue 200); dark is the design base AND the native launch frame (splash/adaptive-icon backgroundColor in apps/mobile/app.config.ts must equal the dark canvas hex — the expo-policy gate asserts the lockstep). contrast pairs are COMPUTED per theme, each asserted >= min; AAA tier: the primary reading pairs (ink/canvas, ink/surface) carry min 7 (WCAG SC 1.4.6 body text) in both themes; ink-muted and the accent/status hues deliberately stay AA 4.5. An out-of-gamut OKLCH value is a generator FAIL: it would be gamut-mapped on screen and the computed ratios would describe a color nobody sees. accentUsageBudget caps accent-token occurrences across apps/mobile/src. controlPrimitives arms the primitive-boundary scan: a raw JSX open-tag for one of `tags` in a .tsx outside `home` is red — interactive controls render through the src/components primitives (Button/Input), and new control styling goes INTO the primitive; controlAllow entries (file + reason) are the reviewed escape. allow entries (file + reason) exempt a file from the raw-hex/raw-dimension source scan. statusSurfaces: a surface carrying one of `signals` must reference a status token — failure and success must never be the same pixel. This file is write-guard-protected: extending the design system is a reviewed human diff of this manifest and the regenerated tokens together.
